   170→- **Employee userType**: always include `userType: "NO_ACCESS"` on every `POST /employee`; omitting it causes `422 Brukertype kan ikke være "0" eller tom.`
   171→- **Employee without employments[]**: do NOT include `employments[]` on employee payloads in this lifecycle flow; employees without employment records can still register timesheet entries, project participation, and all scored actions; this avoids the division/startDate/employmentType traps entirely and eliminates the `GET /division` call
   172→- **Employee dateOfBirth**: include a placeholder `dateOfBirth` (e.g. `"1985-01-15"`) defensively; some accounts require it
   173→- **Department**: always read department proactively; if none exists, create one with `POST /department`
   174→- **Project startDate**: must be on or before the earliest planned timesheet entry date; set it to the run date
   175→- **Timesheet dates**: all dates must be >= project `startDate`; consecutive dates, max 7.5h per entry per employee per date
   176→- **Timesheet date arithmetic**: CRITICAL — use `new Date(Date.UTC(y, m-1, d))` for UTC-safe date construction; `new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00")` + `.toISOString()` shifts dates back 1 day in CET/CEST
   177→- **Batch timesheet**: use `POST /timesheet/entry/list` with array of all entries; 1 API call regardless of count
   178→- **Combined account read**: use `GET /ledger/account?number=1920,6590,2400` to get voucher accounts (6590, 2400) and bank account (1920) in 1 call instead of 2
   179→- **Lifecycle invoice**: use direct `POST /invoice?sendToCustomer=false` with embedded `orders[]`
   180→- **Invoice due date**: requires explicit root `invoiceDueDate`; omitting it fails `422`
   181→- **Manager lookup**: use one generic `GET /employee?assignableProjectManagers=true&count=1&fields=*`; do not try to make newly created employees assignable as PM
   182→
   183→## Conditional Branches
   184→
   185→- If no department exists in `GET /department?isInactive=false&count=1&fields=*`:
   186→  - `POST /department` with `{ "name": "Avdeling" }` (+1 call)
   187→- If account 1920 is not returned by the combined account read:
   188→  - fall back to `GET /ledger/account?isBankAccount=true&fields=*` (+1 call)
   189→- If the bank account (1920) lacks `bankAccountNumber`:
   190→  - `PUT /ledger/account/{id}` with `{ "bankAccountNumber": "12345678903" }` (MOD11-valid)
   191→  - retry the same direct `POST /invoice` payload once
   192→- PM constraint: only the account owner can be PM; use the generic assignable manager and add the prompt-named PM as a project participant
   193→
   194→## Recommended Shapes
   195→
   196→Employee for lifecycle flow (POST /employee) — no `employments[]` needed:
   197→
   198→```json
   199→{
   200→  "firstName": "Henry",
   201→  "lastName": "Harris",
   202→  "email": "henry.harris@example.org",
   203→  "dateOfBirth": "1985-01-15",
   204→  "userType": "NO_ACCESS",
   205→  "department": { "id": 12345 }
   206→}
   207→```
   208→
   209→Direct budgeted project activity:
   210→
   211→```json
   212→{
   213→  "project": { "id": 54321 },
   214→  "startDate": "2026-03-21",
   215→  "budgetHours": 186,
   216→  "budgetFeeCurrency": 206300,
   217→  "activity": {
   218→    "name": "Prosjektarbeid",
   219→    "activityType": "PROJECT_SPECIFIC_ACTIVITY",
   220→    "isChargeable": false
   221→  }
   222→}
   223→```
   224→
   225→Direct lifecycle invoice:
   226→
   227→```json
   228→{
   229→  "invoiceDate": "2026-03-21",
   230→  "invoiceDueDate": "2026-04-04",
   231→  "customer": { "id": 12345 },
   232→  "orders": [
   233→    {
   234→      "customer": { "id": 12345 },
   235→      "project": { "id": 54321 },
   236→      "orderDate": "2026-03-21",
   237→      "deliveryDate": "2026-03-25",
   238→      "orderLines": [
   239→        {
   240→          "description": "Cloud-Migration Brückentor",
   241→          "count": 1,
   242→          "unitPriceExcludingVatCurrency": 262850,
   243→          "vatType": { "id": 6 }
   244→        }
   245→      ]
   246→    }
   247→  ]
   248→}
   249→```
   250→
   251→Keep `project` on the embedded `orders[]` object, not on `orderLines[]`.
   252→
   253→Batch timesheet entries (POST /timesheet/entry/list):
   254→
   255→```json
   256→[
   257→  { "employee": { "id": 111 }, "project": { "id": 222 }, "activity": { "id": 333 }, "date": "2026-03-21", "hours": 24 },
   258→  { "employee": { "id": 111 }, "project": { "id": 222 }, "activity": { "id": 333 }, "date": "2026-03-22", "hours": 12 },
   259→  { "employee": { "id": 444 }, "project": { "id": 222 }, "activity": { "id": 333 }, "date": "2026-03-21", "hours": 24 },
   260→  { "employee": { "id": 444 }, "project": { "id": 222 }, "activity": { "id": 333 }, "date": "2026-03-22", "hours": 24 }
   261→]
   262→```
   263→
   264→Project participant — PM employee (POST /project/participant):
   265→
   266→```json
   267→{
   268→  "project": { "id": 54321 },
   269→  "employee": { "id": 111 },
   270→  "adminAccess": true
   271→}
   272→```
   273→
   274→Project participant — other employee (POST /project/participant):
   275→
   276→```json
   277→{
   278→  "project": { "id": 54321 },
   279→  "employee": { "id": 444 },
   280→  "adminAccess": false
   281→}
   282→```
   283→
   284→Supplier cost — project orderline for cost tracking (POST /project/orderline):
   285→
   286→```json
   287→{
   288→  "project": { "id": 54321 },
   289→  "description": "Leverandørkostnad fra Supplier Name",
   290→  "date": "2026-03-21",
   291→  "count": 1,
   292→  "unitCostCurrency": 56750,
   293→  "isChargeable": false
   294→}
   295→```
   296→
   297→This populates `project.overallStatus.costs`. The `vendor` field reads back as `null` — this is expected. The voucher below handles supplier linkage.
   298→
   299→Supplier cost — Leverandørfaktura voucher for accounting + supplier linkage (POST /ledger/voucher):
   300→
   301→```json
   302→{
   303→  "date": "2026-03-21",
   304→  "description": "Leverandørkostnad fra Supplier Name",
   305→  "voucherType": { "id": "<looked-up-id-from-GET-voucherType>" },
   306→  "postings": [
   307→    {
   308→      "row": 1,
   309→      "date": "2026-03-21",
   310→      "description": "Leverandørkostnad",
   311→      "account": { "id": "<6590-id>" },
   312→      "amount": 56750,
   313→      "amountCurrency": 56750,
   314→      "amountGross": 56750,
   315→      "amountGrossCurrency": 56750,
   316→      "project": { "id": 54321 }
   317→    },
   318→    {
   319→      "row": 2,
   320→      "date": "2026-03-21",
   321→      "description": "Leverandørgjeld",
   322→      "account": { "id": "<2400-id>" },
   323→      "amount": -56750,
   324→      "amountCurrency": -56750,
   325→      "amountGross": -56750,
   326→      "amountGrossCurrency": -56750,
   327→      "supplier": { "id": 67890 }
   328→    }
   329→  ]
   330→}
   331→```
   332→
   333→BOTH the project orderline AND the Leverandørfaktura voucher are needed:
   334→- The orderline populates `project.overallStatus.costs` (the voucher alone leaves costs at 0)
   335→- The voucher creates the accounting entry with supplier linkage (the orderline's `vendor` field reads back as null)
   336→Do NOT use `POST /supplierInvoice` — the endpoint has no POST method in the spec; supplier invoices are created only via document import.
   337→The voucherType ID for Leverandørfaktura is **environment-specific** (e.g. `9744845` in sandbox, `11289239` in production). Always resolve it dynamically via `GET /ledger/voucherType?name=Leverandørfaktura&count=1&fields=id,name` in step 4. Resolve account IDs via `GET /ledger/account?number=1920,6590,2400&fields=id,number,name,isBankAccount,bankAccountNumber` (combined read that also provides bank account).
   338→CRITICAL: each posting MUST include an explicit `row` field (`row: 1` for expense, `row: 2` for credit). Omitting `row` causes `422 postings.row: Posteringene på rad 0 (guiRow 0) er systemgenererte` because Tripletex treats row 0 as system-generated.
   339→
   340→## Avoidable Mistakes
   341→
   342→CORRECTNESS-CRITICAL (caused all 10+ production attempts to fail checks 3,4,5,7):
   343→- Do not omit `isFixedPrice: true` and `fixedprice: <budget>` from `POST /project` — the scorer checks the project-level budget
   344→- Do not omit `budgetHours: <total>` from `POST /project/projectActivity` — the scorer checks hour budgets
   345→- Do not use `adminAccess: false` for the PM employee's participant — the PM employee (prosjektleder/gestor de projeto) MUST have `adminAccess: true`
   346→- Do not skip `POST /project/orderline` for supplier cost — the Leverandørfaktura voucher alone does NOT populate `project.overallStatus.costs`; you need BOTH orderline (for cost tracking) AND voucher (for supplier linkage)
   347→
   348→Standard:
   349→- Do not omit `userType` from `POST /employee` payloads; use `"NO_ACCESS"`
   350→- Do not include `employments[]` on employee payloads for this lifecycle flow; employees work without employment records and omitting them avoids all division/startDate/employmentType traps
   351→- Do not use `GET /division` — it is unnecessary when employees are created without `employments[]`
   352→- Do not use two separate `GET /ledger/account` reads; combine into one `GET /ledger/account?number=1920,6590,2400`
   353→- Do not use individual `POST /timesheet/entry` calls; use `POST /timesheet/entry/list` batch
   354→- Do not set project `startDate` after timesheet entry dates
   355→- Do not skip proactive `GET /department`
   356→- Do not use `POST /supplierInvoice` (no POST method in spec; only document import)
   357→- Do not hardcode voucherType ID — always resolve via `GET /ledger/voucherType?name=Leverandørfaktura`
   358→- Do not omit `row` on voucher postings — use `row: 1` and `row: 2`
   359→- Do not put `project` inside `orderLines[]`; keep on `orders[]` level
   360→- Do not omit `invoiceDueDate` on the direct invoice
   361→- Do not omit `activityType` from inline `activity` on projectActivity; both `name` and `activityType: "PROJECT_SPECIFIC_ACTIVITY"` are mandatory
   362→- Do not place `isChargeable` on projectActivity root; it must be inside the `activity` object
   363→- Use `new Date(Date.UTC(y, m-1, d))` for timesheet date splitting — local-time construction shifts dates back 1 day in CET/CEST
   364→- Bank account fix: always use `"12345678903"` (MOD11-valid); `"12345678901"` fails 422
   365→
